settings.title: Settings
settings.manualBackup: Other ways to back up (one file, no photos)
settings.autoBackupHelp: Choose a folder, e.g. on Google Drive. When the app opens and 7 days have passed since the last copy and something changed, it saves a copy there by itself. The 5 latest stay. First I check that the folder can be written to. On a new phone choose the same folder, then “Restore from a copy in the folder”.
settings.autoNever: No automatic copy has been made yet.
settings.backupNowDone: Saved the copy “{{name}}” ({{kb}} KB). Copies in the folder: {{count}}.
settings.showCopies: Restore from a copy in the folder…
settings.noCopies: No copies in the folder yet.
settings.restoreQuestion: The data from the copy of {{when}} will be merged with what is on the phone. Newer entries win, nothing is deleted.
settings.folderFailed: Could not write to this folder: {{message}}
settings.backupHelp: Export saves all data in one file, without photos; handy to send yourself a copy or to move the data without a backup folder. Import merges a file with the app: newer entries win, nothing is deleted. Import also reads an automatic copy (.json.gz).
settings.csv: Import crags from a CSV file
settings.csvHelp: Pick one file with a list of routes (e.g. a guidebook export or a theCrag export). Each row is one route: region, area, group, crag, sector, name, grade. A file with columns Crag, lat, lng only saves crag positions for the map.
settings.csvSkipped: Rows left out: {{count}} (boulders, ice, via ferratas, unnamed routes, projects, routes without a grade or with an unknown grade).
settings.removeImportedHelp: Before loading a file that should replace the previous one. Routes with your ascents and everything you added yourself stay.
settings.removeImportedConfirm: This removes {{routes}} routes and {{crags}} crags. Routes with your ascents and everything you added yourself stay.
settings.removeImportedNone: There is no imported data to remove.
settings.csvUnknown: File {{file}} was not recognised. The first row should hold headers, e.g. Region;Area;Crag;Name;Grade.
settings.notBackup: This file is not a Cruxlog backup.
settings.positionsConfirm: The file has crag positions: {{count}}. They will be saved on crags with the same name or key. Routes and ascents will not change.
settings.positionsNone: The file has no valid position.
settings.positionsApprox: Of these approximate (worked out from nearby crags): {{count}}. They show as a hollow dot on the map.
settings.positionsKept: Unchanged because you set them on the phone: {{count}}.
settings.positionsUnmatched: Crags not found in the app: {{count}} ({{names}}).
settings.csvConfirm: {{crags}} crags and {{routes}} routes will be imported. If this file was imported before, your changes to these crags and routes are overwritten and deleted ones come back. Your ascents are not changed.
